description: 危機管理型水位計観測データ [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 水文観測のcsvデータをダウンロードできます。 公開データは、観測局から送られてくるデータをそのまま反映しているものであり、観測機器の故障、通信異常などによる欠測や異常値を含んでいる可能性があります。 したがって、防災面での利用や統計データとしての利用には十分注意して下さい。. Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 防災. It offers 10 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
